parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: Propanoic acid, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$, reacts with reducing agent $\mathbf{Q}$ to produce propan-1-ol, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$.
parts.text: Suggest the formula of reducing agent $\mathbf{Q}$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Complete the equation to show the reduction of propanoic acid to propan-1-ol.

Use $\text{[H]}$ to represent one atom of hydrogen from $\mathbf{Q}$.

$$\ldots\ldots\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH} + \ldots\ldots\text{[H]} \rightarrow \ldots\ldots\ldots\ldots$$

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Propan-1-ol is converted to compound $\mathbf{T}$ in a three-step synthesis.

In step 1, $\text{SOCl}_2$ is added to propan-1-ol to produce compound $\mathbf{E}$.

In step 2, $\mathbf{E}$ reacts with a suitable reagent to produce butanenitrile.

In step 3, butanenitrile is heated with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.
parts.text: Name the type of reaction that occurs in step 1.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the reagent and conditions required in step 2.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Construct an equation to describe the reaction of butanenitrile with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ in step 3.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction that occurs in step 3.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: Compounds $\mathbf{A}$, $\mathbf{B}$ and $\mathbf{C}$ belong to the alcohol homologous series. Each molecule of $\mathbf{A}$, $\mathbf{B}$ and $\mathbf{C}$ contains four saturated carbon atoms.
parts.text: Identify the type of hybridisation shown in the saturated carbon atoms of all alcohols.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the gas produced when $\text{Na(s)}$ is added to separate samples of each alcohol.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Describe the role of $\text{Na(s)}$ when it reacts with alcohols.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
Table 4.1 shows the results of two tests on separate samples of $\mathbf{A}$, $\mathbf{B}$ and $\mathbf{C}$.

Table 4.1

| compound | heat under reflux with acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$ | warm with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $\mathbf{A}$ | remains orange | no visible change |
| $\mathbf{B}$ | orange to green | no visible change |
| $\mathbf{C}$ | orange to green | pale yellow precipitate |
